mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,l.excerpt_id AS baseline_excerpt_id,l.attachment_id AS baseline_attachment_id, l.status,l.ai_use,l.revision,l.created_at,l.updated_at,e.created_at AS excerpt_created_at FROM material_excerpt e JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id AND a.sha256=e.attachment_sha256 AND a.status='READY' LEFT JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle l ON l.owner_id=e.owner_id AND l.excerpt_id=e.id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{id}

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_material_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_draft_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_material_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_source_qa_source WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM standard_review_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_material_reference WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_relation_evidence_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM standard_review_evidence WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id}) OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM ( SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose IN ('KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT','QUESTION_DRAFT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported FROM ai_material_draft_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='MATERIAL_QA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported FROM ai_material_qa_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='FACT_DRAFT' AND s.kind='MATERIAL' AND p.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported FROM ai_fact_draft_material s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_fact_draft_source p ON p.owner_id=s.owner_id AND p.task_id=s.task_id AND p.kind=s.kind WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='RELATION_DRAFT' AND s.kind='MATERIAL' AND p.task_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported FROM ai_relation_evidence_material s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_relation_evidence_source p ON p.owner_id=s.owner_id AND p.task_id=s.task_id AND p.kind=s.kind WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} UNION ALL SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id, CASE WHEN t.id IS NOT NULL AND t.purpose='SOURCE_QA' AND s.domain='MATERIAL_EXCERPT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS supported FROM ai_source_qa_source s LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.excerpt_id=#{id} ) registered
WHERE registered.supported=0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_candidate_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_question_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_fact_draft_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_relation_decision d WHERE d.owner_id=registered.owner_id AND d.task_id=registered.task_id AND (d.status IS NULL OR d.status<>'IGNORED')) )

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM material_excerpt e LEFT JOIN material_excerpt_lifecycle l ON l.owner_id=e.owner_id AND l.excerpt_id=e.id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND (l.excerpt_id IS NULL OR l.attachment_id<>e.attachment_id OR l.created_at<>e.created_at OR l.status NOT IN ('ACTIVE','ARCHIVED') OR l.ai_use NOT IN ('ALLOWED','REVOKED') OR l.revision<0 OR l.revision>9007199254740991 OR l.updated_at<l.created_at OR (l.revision=0 AND (l.status<>'ACTIVE' OR l.ai_use<>'ALLOWED' OR l.updated_at<>l.created_at))))
mapper.update: UPDATE material_excerpt_lifecycle SET status=#{status},ai_use=#{aiUse},revision=revision+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND excerpt_id=#{id} AND revision=#{expected} AND revision<9007199254740991
